name: sign-up-form
title: Sign-up form
description: Account creation with default name/email fields or ordered text/email fields (values.fields), a password strength meter and required consent (terms=false opts out). minPasswordLength defaults to 8 and drives length validation and the insufficient-length meter; optional passwordHelp can receive the minimum. Configured fields support help, required, autoComplete and validation messages, with a linked validation summary on invalid submit. policyLoading renders skeletons without a form; unavailable replaces the form with consumer title, message and optional action. loading remains submitting; error is form-level feedback. Examples: custom-fields, no-terms, unavailable, loading, submitting and error. Optional labels?: Partial<SignUpFormLabels> overrides built-in copy; explicit props and validation messages win, then labels, then I18nProvider (en/es). No provider preserves English; fixtures and caller content stay unchanged. Interactive preview: /preview.html?kind=block&id=sign-up-form--labels.
author: gntik-ai
